# Dependency Upgrade

**Version:** `1.0.0` · **License:** [MIT](../../LICENSE)

## Purpose

Upgrade packages, frameworks, runtimes, SDKs, compilers, or build tools while
preserving supported behavior.

## When it applies

This skill applies to version bumps, security updates, dependency conflicts,
and same-technology major upgrades. Replacing the technology itself is outside
its scope.

## Capabilities

- Inventories direct, transitive, generated, and configuration dependencies.
- Selects a supported target version from authoritative upstream evidence.
- Updates manifests, lockfiles, APIs, configuration, and generated code.
- Removes obsolete compatibility paths and resolves dependency conflicts.
- Verifies behavior, security, licensing, deployment, and rollback concerns.

## Sample prompts

- "Upgrade Nuxt and remove old compatibility code."
- "Bump this project to the latest major version of React and fix breakages."
- "Update our dependencies to patch the reported security vulnerabilities."
- "Move this service to the new major version of the SDK."
- "Upgrade our build tooling and clean up any legacy config it leaves behind."
